why: Intro to the terminal plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-terminal.json), 'Pipes and grep' (passes: rain.txt holds every line that mentions rain, in sorted order). The learner typed `grep -i rain notes/*.txt > rain.txt | sort`: the redirect sends grep's lines straight into rain.txt and sort gets nothing. `cat rain.txt` shows the rain lines in grep's order ('Woke to rain' before 'Afternoon rain'), not sorted. Every rain line is there, but the file isn't sorted.

step.title: Save the sorted rain lines
step.instructions: In trail-log, run grep -i rain notes/*.txt | sort > rain.txt to save every line that mentions rain, sorted, into rain.txt. Then run cat rain.txt to check it.
